L-shaped[-1,1]² minus quadrantIV, theta0..3pi/2, analytic Dirichlet harmonic corner field. N8/16/32, fixed map x→x max(|x|,|y|). Separate unit-square sine MMS uses regular/warped grids. Integrate the analytic corner field and gradient over elements, comparing uniform and a-priori graded meshes at matched DOFs.
